preflight.remediation: Install pinned GreenFrame CLI 2.0.1 locally and pull the required image; no host permission changes are performed

measurementBoundary: GreenFrame modeled browser-container CPU, memory, disk and screen energy; network modeled separately; remote servers excluded

protocol.journey: Fresh browser context; initial navigation waits for load then 3000 ms; no consent action or scrolling
protocol.measurementWindow: Starts after browser/context startup and upstream 2000 ms warm-up; ends after scenario and browser close; fresh context per repetition, same browser container across repetitions
protocol.execution: Sequential; shared workstation, uncontrolled ambient activity
protocol.userAgent: GreenFrame fixed Chrome/89 user agent; not the actual browser version

limitations: Resource-counter model; not measured electricity, whole device energy or remote server energy
Client-device headline excludes GreenFrame modeled network energy, which is listed separately
Synthetic 45 W CPU and 14 W screen coefficients; CPU counters normalized by available host CPUs
Never add to SWDM emissions; annual scenarios require explicit traffic, page-mix and electricity assumptions
Bounded energy sample may be smaller than the report's browser page sample

pages.measurementBoundary: GreenFrame modeled browser-container CPU, memory, disk and screen energy; network modeled separately; remote servers excluded
pages.comparisonRule: Independent complete scenarios, not incremental phase energy; retain first-load result as headline and compare matched repeated scenarios
pages.limitations: Modeled Wh and gCO2e, not RAPL or wall-meter energy; never add to SWDM; annual projection requires explicit traffic, page-mix and electricity assumptions. Runner image/browser versions require separate verification before comparing runs.
pages.error: ValueError: GreenFrame runner failed; inspect private runner.log
